name: GetSparkSQLEngineState

<props="intl">The ID of the Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.</props>

parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the job resource group

Data.description_en: The status details of the Spark SQL engine
Data.description_zh: Spark SQL 引擎状态详情

Config.description_en: The configuration of the Spark application

MaxExecutor.description_en: The maximum number of Spark executors to start

MinExecutor.description_en: The minimum number of Spark executors to start

SlotNum.description_en: The slot value of the Spark application

State.description_en:
The execution status of the application. Valid values:
SUBMITTED: Submitted.
STARTING: Starting.
RUNNING: Running.
FAILING: The task failed and the environment is being cleaned up.
FAILED: Failed.
KILLING: The task is being terminated and the environment is being cleaned up.
KILLED: Terminated.
SUCCEEDING: The task execution is complete and the environment is being cleaned up.
COMPLETED: Completed.
FATAL: Unexpected failure.
UNKNOWN: Unknown error
State.description_zh:
应用执行状态，取值说明：
SUBMITTED：已提交。
STARTING：开始启动。
RUNNING：执行中。
FAILING：任务失败，清理环境中。
FAILED：失败。
KILLING：中止任务，清理环境中。
KILLED：中止任务。
SUCCEEDING：任务执行结束，清理环境中。
COMPLETED：已完成。
FATAL：意外失败。
UNKNOWN：未知错误

SubmittedTimeInMillis.description_en: The submission time of the Spark SQL application. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
SubmittedTimeInMillis.description_zh: Spark SQL 应用的提交时间，Unix时间戳，单位毫秒（ms）
